name: op1-start-year-s0
description: OP1 (docs/HARNESS-CHALLENGE.md §4.1): one in-game year from a fresh 7-dwarf 'Play now!' embark. Public: the default start fort (fort_start_snapshot, or its seed-built replacement embark-default-fort-12345; docs/SEED-FORTS.md §6). Private: four fresh TEMPERATE_SOIL embarks from the season's secret seeds (embark/make_embark.sh with the seed in the param set), the same 7-dwarf loadout on a map nobody has seen.

embark.build: private: pool/dfpool build (kind embark); public: docker/embark.sh --rules DEFAULT_FORT --seeds 12345

pool_note: Private pool (pool/README.md): `snapshot_pool_private` holds placeholders that `pool/dfpool stage` resolves to the season's sealed forts (scenarios/snapshots/<season>-<task>-p<i> under DFBENCH_SNAPSHOTS_DIR); the staged copy drops `snapshot` and sets `snapshot_pool`. Without staging, the task runs on the public `snapshot` (the default start fort) (competitors' local runs).
goal: Run the fortress for {days} days. Scored on how the fortress is doing (see SCORE): dwarves alive, drink and food kept in stock to the end, wellbeing, and beds and dining for everyone.
provenance: Season-0 copy of scenarios/start-year.json (same goal, metrics and horizon) with the private-pool placeholders. The public start differs from the private ones in site class (DEFAULT_FORT shrubland vs TEMPERATE_SOIL); both are 7-dwarf spring embarks.
